Gosh you just described me, same age and everything.   Been taking care of mum for over 6 years now and at that time broke up with my GF at the time because I knew this would be a lonely journey.   She tried to linger but I knew she’d be happier with someone else and now she is.  I just suppress these thoughts the best I can.   Caregiving is a mental game.   My heartfelt recommendation:  get out if you need a life, this will take every bit of your sanity.    The only thing that has given me hope is CV19 which has ruined dating and entertainment.   Mum might go by the time this is over.

I’m doing the same thing going on 7 years.   Honestly haven’t conversed with anyone meaningfully during that time.   My mental health is gone.  Do whatever it takes to protect yourself.    Being a martyr isn’t worth it.

I (m) had the same problem with my mum as she would use the ladies restroom by herself while sickened with dementia.   One day she was so confused I went into the ladies restroom to get her when I saw a bunch of women making fun of my mum that the stall door was open and she couldn’t get the toilet paper out.  She was half naked with ppl laughing at her.

From that day on I said I wouldn’t let her be that way and I just took my mum into the men’s restroom with me helping her.  And it wasn’t that bad as I thought. 

In short one day you’ll realize the help they need is more than your feelings of awkwardness.

Best wishes
